meta.name: codex
meta.description: Claude x Codex bridge — delegate mechanical or bulk implementation to the OpenAI Codex CLI, get an independent cross-model review of the current uncommitted diff, or ask Codex a read-only second-opinion question. Triggers "use codex", "have codex do", "have codex review", "have codex check", "codex exec", "second opinion from codex", "cross-check with codex", "delegate to codex", "ask codex". Use when you want a different model family to verify your own diff, parallelize bulk work, or get a fast read-only opinion without spending Claude turns.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 委托机械性实现或获取跨模型代码审查
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在多个模型间并行工作或获取独立审查
copy.tagline_en: Delegate mechanical implementation or get cross-model code review
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to parallelize work or get an independent code review from another model

howto.what: Claude 可以将机械性或批量编码任务委托给 OpenAI Codex CLI，让 Codex 审查当前未提交的代码差异，或向 Codex 提问获取快速只读意见。
howto.when: 当你想用不同模型验证自己的代码差异、并行处理批量工作，或在不消耗 Claude 轮次时快速获取意见，使用“use codex”等关键词触发。

say.text: 让 Codex 执行批量文件脚手架。
say.note: Codex 会在工作区生成文件，完成后审核差异。

say.text: 让 Codex 审查当前代码差异。
say.note: Codex 会报告问题（高/中/低严重性）。

say.text: 向 Codex 询问架构意见。
say.note: 不修改代码，只返回建议。

howto.what_en: Claude can delegate mechanical or bulk coding tasks to OpenAI Codex CLI, ask Codex to review the current uncommitted diff, or get a fast read-only opinion by asking Codex a question.
howto.when_en: When you want a different model to verify your diff, parallelize bulk work, or get a fast read-only opinion without spending Claude turns, use trigger phrases like 'use codex'.

say_en.text: Ask Codex to do bulk file scaffolding.
say_en.note: Codex generates files in a sandbox; review the diff afterwards.

say_en.text: Have Codex review the current diff.
Ask Codex for an architecture opinion.
